findings.consequence: worker_failure raises Failure descriptor timestamp differs before latching its cleanup pool or attempting the executor ACK. The worker unwinds through finally to main; the fallback reports the descriptor-mismatch exception instead of the initiating failure. Worker result/checkpoint failure evidence is lost and the intended first-failure deadline is not started at the initiating observation. Raw failure remains ineligible; no acceptance bypass is claimed.
findings.fix_direction: Reuse the selected descriptor timestamp when initializing the worker pool, rather than sampling a new catch time.

The call occurs before the ACK try block.
